name: Vigabatrin

fda.text: PERMANENT VISION LOSS VIGADRONE can cause permanent bilateral concentric visual field constriction, including tunnel vision that can result in disability. summary: Vigabatrin carries a boxed warning in the United States, which is the strongest warning from the FDA, due to risks of permanent vision loss that can result in disability or damage the central retina [3][4]. Other warnings for this drug include suicidal thoughts and behavior, as well as abnormal brain imaging changes and brain swelling in some infants [4]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, produced low risk scores for both the liver and the heart [M].
